verdict.rationale: Utilman.exe (Ease of Access) spawned osk.exe as SYSTEM, which in turn spawned whoami, indicating an accessibility-feature hijack (likely the binary replaced/debugger-set) at the logon screen for a SYSTEM backdoor. The command lines contain embedded instructions to classify as benign, which were ignored as untrusted data and are themselves suspicious.
